episodes.title: Familia Kawanda
episodes.summary: As the bills pile up and his farmer neighbors start paying him in eggs, Antón swallows his pride and considers a job at his niece's fancy pet store.

episodes.title: Sonrisa llama a sonrisa
episodes.summary: Grumpy Antón and upbeat Uxía's clashing personalities cause tension at home and work. After a run of bad reviews, Antón rethinks his customer service.

episodes.title: Frases de taza
episodes.summary: Furious that his old neighbors have found a new vet, Antón abandons Kawanda to prove his replacement a fraud — on the eve of a major poodle contest.

episodes.title: Una ansiedad de cobaya
episodes.summary: Antón grapples with anxiety — which isn't helped by corrupt farmers, strained relations with Sabela, Uxía's new boyfriend… or a pregnant guinea pig.

episodes.title: Fundación Kawanda
episodes.summary: Tired of life at Kawanda, Antón considers changing his moral stance to return to farm life — but first he must convince Nuno to replace him.

episodes.title: El último paseo
episodes.summary: Antón panics over the potential fallout from his work for the Andrades. As Uxía's ex attempts to patch things up, Nuno makes a startling announcement.

episodes.title: La visita
episodes.summary: Kawanda gets an inspection from the corporate headquarters. Antón's anxiety builds as he learns the authorities are investigating the Andrades' business.

episodes.title: Las cataratas del Niágara
episodes.summary: When the Andrades need his skills to save a seriously sick cow, Antón gets a chance at redemption in the eyes of Uxía, Sabela — and himself.

episodes.title: Un día de perros
episodes.summary: Antón finds himself in front of a judge. Uxía learns head office has plans to replace her. An outbreak of doggy stomach flu takes over Kawanda.
